messages.subject: scale_datetime() and range
messages.body_plain:
I cannot get range= to work with scale_datetime():

set.seed(2934)

dat <- data.frame(
time = as.Date("2013-07-01") + 1:100,
value = seq(1, 10, length.out = 100) + rnorm(100)
)

p <- dat %>% ggvis(~time, ~value) %>% layer_points()
#works:
p %>% scale_datetime("x",nice = "month")
#does not work:
p %>% scale_datetime("x",nice = "month",range=c(as.Date("2013-08-01"),max(dat$time)))

#Error message:
#Error: x is not a numeric or integer vector

Why is it so?

messages.subject: Color lines that are between selected points
messages.subject_clean: Color lines that are between selected points
messages.body_plain:
In the code below, for the mtcars dataset, if you click a point only the cars that have the same number of gears become red. As you can see, there are lines between cars of the same number of gears. What I would like to do is to make the lines red also. That is, if I select a point, the points with the same number of gear as well as the lines between them become red. Any help will be really appreciated. I have posted this in stack overflow <http://stackoverflow.com/questions/30986090/only-color-lines-that-are-between-selected-points-ggvis> too.

 library(ggvis)

lb <- linked_brush(keys = 1:nrow(mtcars), "red")

mtcars %>%
  ggvis(~mpg, ~wt) %>%
  layer_points(fill := lb$fill, fill.brush := "red") %>%
  group_by(gear) %>%
  layer_lines() %>%
  lb$input() %>%
  set_options(width = 300, height = 300) %>%
  layer_points(fill := "red", data = reactive(mtcars[mtcars$gear %in% mtcars[lb$selected(),]$gear, ]))
Also, if someone can point me to a ggvis interactivity tutorial that talks about interactivity within the plot (like making things happen by clicking on the plot), that would be great. I have gone through the interactivity tutorial in the ggvis website, but it mostly talks about using widgets like input sliders and other things. Thanks.

messages.subject: ggvis svg export with tooltips
messages.body_plain:
I am trying to use ggvis to export a chart to an svg file including tooltips
mtcars1 <- mtcars %>%
 add_rownames("name")

on_hover <- function(x) {
 if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
 x$name
}

mtcars1 %>%
 ggvis(~cyl,~hp,key := ~name) %>%
 layer_points() %>%
 add_tooltip(on_hover,"hover") %>%
 export_svg("mcars.svg")
Everything works fine without the export_svg call, but when I export, the svg file does not contain the tootips. Is there a way to add the tooltips?

messages.subject: Re: ggvis svg export with tooltips
messages.body_plain:
The tooltips are added dynamically by R, so no.
Hadley
